worker_context: fresh agent via fork_turns=none; no target title, author, URL, design or results in worker prompt
isolation: instruction-based shared-filesystem segregation; not operating-system access isolation

cases.question: 完全資訊、無限期、輪流出價且各自承擔等待成本的兩人談判，均衡分配與達成協議的時點如何決定？

evaluation_ground_truth_source: primary publication / author-hosted published copy; original code is a diagnostic artifact, not the numerical truth authority
evaluation_status: complete: interrupted two-case pilot evaluated; full reconstruction and all-gate delivery not achieved
review_policy: after attempt artifacts exist, dispatch fresh-context reviewer without author confidence or target answers; material corrections count as internal iterations
reporting_rules: Do not claim academic publication acceptance or novelty from historical reconstruction.
Record target/source memory exposure, actual computations and empirical input availability separately.
Never equate an opt-in package pass with full original-paper reconstruction.
Record gates as pass, fail, not_run or blocked; do not turn absent gates into passes.
Only freeze and evaluate actual artifacts; preserve failures.
additional_usage_interruptions: Workers hit another usage limit after reviews/artifacts; final posthoc evaluation resumed on user instruction without altering scientific artifacts.
